task.name: Grand Mining Expedition - Five-Team Advanced Ore Processing
task.description: Five agents work together to establish a complete mining and smelting operation, producing advanced metal equipment through coordinated resource gathering and crafting

objectives.primary: Establish a complete mining-to-crafting pipeline with five specialized agents to produce advanced metal equipment
secondary: Coordinate five-agent mining expedition across multiple ore types
Execute advanced smelting operations with proper fuel management
Complete coordinated crafting of multiple equipment pieces
Achieve all objectives within 50 rounds with five-agent coordination

success_criteria: IronMinerAlpha successfully mines iron ore and shares with team
CoalMinerBeta successfully mines coal and distributes for smelting
MasterSmelterGamma successfully smelts iron bars from ore and coal
EquipmentCrafterDelta successfully crafts pickaxe, axe, and heavy sword
LogisticsCoordinatorEpsilon successfully gathers logs and coordinates transfers
Team produces 1x pickaxe through coordinated effort
Team produces 1x axe through coordinated effort
Team produces 1x heavy sword through coordinated effort
All five agents coordinate effectively using global chat
Resources are shared efficiently among all team members
Team completes entire mining-to-crafting pipeline within time limit
All agents demonstrate effective five-agent coordination throughout operation
